SELECT f.market_ticker,f.filled_at,
f.raw_fill_json->>'created_time' AS exchange_created_time,
f.raw_fill_json->>'ts' AS exchange_ts,
f.raw_fill_json->>'count_fp' AS exchange_count,
f.raw_fill_json->>'fee_cost' AS exchange_fee,
o.created_at AS order_created_at,o.strategy,
f.filled_at=o.created_at AS fill_equals_order_created_at
FROM fills f JOIN live_orders o ON o.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id
AND o.id=(SELECT min(x.id) FROM live_orders x WHERE x.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id)
WHERE f.market_ticker='KXINXU-26AUG10H1600-T7774.9999' AND o.strategy ILIKE '%mmsell%'
ORDER BY f.filled_at
